body:
Connor Mankit Darigo，道号黄源杰，师承吉法新道长，为净明派第二十七代弟子。

黄源杰信仰并研习道教已有八年，对道教经典、教义思想、科仪传统与修持实践有着浓厚兴趣，并长期关注道教文化在英语语境中的传播与教育。

他致力于道教经典及相关文献的英文翻译与整理，希望通过准确、易于理解的英文表达，帮助更多英语使用者认识和了解道教的信仰体系、思想传统与宗教文化，为道教在英语世界的传播与交流贡献力量。
body_en:
Connor Mankit Darigo, Taoist name Huang Yuanjie, is a 27th-generation disciple of the Jingming Taoist tradition under the guidance of Dpr. Zhouxinyu Ji.

He has practiced and studied Taoism for eight years and has a strong interest in Taoist scriptures, teachings, ritual traditions, and cultivation practices. He is also deeply interested in the communication and education of Taoist culture in the English-speaking world.

Connor is dedicated to the English translation and study of Taoist scriptures and related texts. Through accurate and accessible translations, he hopes to help more English-speaking audiences understand Taoist beliefs, philosophy, traditions, and religious culture, contributing to the broader communication and understanding of Taoism in the English-speaking world.
title: 黄法诚
